description: PlatformIO Core - cross-platform build system, debugger and library/toolchain manager for embedded development. Installs the PyPI package 'platformio'; the commands are 'pio', 'platformio' and 'piodebuggdb'.
notes: Toolchains, frameworks and board definitions live in scoop\persist\platformio\home instead of the default %USERPROFILE%\.platformio - this manifest points PLATFORMIO_CORE_DIR there, the same way paseo relocates PASEO_HOME. Scoop preserves it across update and uninstall, so nothing is re-downloaded.

Migrating an existing install: move packages, platforms and .cache out of %USERPROFILE%\.platformio into scoop\persist\platformio\home. Otherwise PlatformIO starts empty and re-downloads every toolchain (easily several GB), and the old directory is left behind.

The variable has to be a real environment variable rather than something a wrapper sets: the PlatformIO IDE extension runs 'platformio.exe' through a non-shell spawn, so a .cmd wrapper would not be found at all. It shadows nothing, and 'scoop uninstall' removes it again.

To make the PlatformIO IDE extension (VS Code, CLion) use this install, set "platformio-ide.useBuiltinPIOCore": false - it then takes platformio from PATH, which is this package's shim, and inherits the core dir above. Restart the editor so it picks up the variable.
Python itself is handled for you: uv downloads a managed interpreter per the package's requires-python (>=3.9) and shares it with this bucket's other Python tools.
